name: OpenWA
short_desc: Open-source WhatsApp API gateway with a built-in dashboard.
author: rmyndharis
description: Self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway with sessions, webhooks and a web dashboard.

form_fields.label: API master key
form_fields.hint: Seeds the admin key on first start only. Keep a copy: you need it for the dashboard and the API.
form_fields.pattern_error: Use at least 32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.

form_fields.label: Enable MCP server
form_fields.hint: Serves the MCP endpoint for AI agents at /mcp on the app port.

form_fields.label: MCP read-only
form_fields.hint: Turn off to also let agents send messages and change groups.
